# Repository collaboration configuration

The [pull request template](PULL_REQUEST_TEMPLATE.md) requires explicit independent approval, current per-directory READMEs, and removal of resolved review reports. [CI](workflows/README.md) performs repository verification with a PostgreSQL 16 fixture, four-library artifact generation, archive/POM inspection, and external packaged-consumer compilation/execution. The [build contract](../project/README.md#local-artifact-packaging) records current workflow identity and local evidence; the manual unsigned candidate workflow has final source/full/artifact verification and combined documentation approval in the [preparation contract](../verification/artifact-consumer/README.md#candidate-preparation-acceptance); remote CI and publication remain unconfirmed.
